text_for_embedding: Default national requirements for a new National Identity Card (NIC). Applicants must visit the Department for Registration of Persons in Battaramulla. Required documents include existing old NIC, Birth Certificate, and Grama Niladhari certificate. Fees are LKR 500 for normal processing (1-3 months) and LKR 1500 for urgent processing (1 week). Official PDF form available: nic_application_form.pdf.

text_for_embedding: Requirements for renewing an NIC or getting a new card when an old NIC exists through the Department for Registration of Persons. Applicants must get documents certified at their Grama Niladhari (GN) office and submit through the Divisional Secretariat or NIC office. Required documents include the Old NIC, Birth Certificate (if required), New NIC photo receipt, Application form, and Address proof if details changed. The standard renewal fee is Rs. 200, and one-day service is available for an extra Rs. 2,000.

text_for_embedding: Procedures for replacing a lost Sri Lankan NIC. First, make a police complaint at the nearest station and obtain a copy of the report[cite: 1]. Obtain a replacement NIC application form from your Grama Niladhari (GN) office or a relevant NIC service office[cite: 1]. Prepare necessary documents, including the police complaint copy, birth certificate, approved studio photo receipt, and the application form certified by the GN[cite: 1]. Submit the application through your GN office or Divisional Secretariat[cite: 1]. The fee for a replacement is LKR 1,000, with an additional LKR 2,000 for one-day service if available[cite: 1].

text_for_embedding: Procedures for first registration of a vehicle through the Department of Motor Traffic (DMT)[cite: 2]. Applicants must obtain the MTA 2 form from the DMT or download it from their website[cite: 2]. Required documentation includes a certified copy of the owner's NIC, purchase invoice, insurance certificate, and relevant customs documents for imports[cite: 2]. A vehicle physical inspection of engine and chassis numbers is mandatory before paying registration fees[cite: 2]. Standard entry level registration charges for a motor car below 1600cc comprise a registration fee of LKR 25,000, plate fee of LKR 3,300, inspection fee of LKR 1,000, and documentation fee of LKR 150[cite: 2].

text_for_embedding: Procedures for a passport renewal through the Department of Immigration and Emigration Sri Lanka[cite: 3]. Applicants must submit their current passport, national identity card (NIC), and a completed passport application form[cite: 3]. The standard renewal fee is LKR 10,000 for normal service, LKR 20,000 for one-day / urgent service, and LKR 3,000 for a child passport renewal if applicable[cite: 3]. The expected processing timeline ranges from 1 to 14 days[cite: 3].

text_for_embedding: Can I get my birth certificate from another city in Sri Lanka? Yes. Applicants may apply through any Divisional Secretariat or District Registrar Office even if the birth was registered in a different district.

Can Sri Lankan citizens obtain a birth certificate from abroad? Yes. Applications can be made through Sri Lankan embassies, high commissions, authorized representatives or online certificate request services.
